name: Future Tools
tagline: Future Tools is a hand-curated directory of AI tools built by content creator Matt Wolfe, who screens every submission before it's listed. Entries are grouped by category (writing, video, productivity, and more) with a 'most saved' and 'newest' view, plus a running news feed of AI developments tied to his YouTube channel. It skips the noise of auto-scraped directories in favour of a smaller, vetted list.
